sources.entry: 11. Aito.ai - AI database and predictive APIs.

summary.name: Aito
summary.one_liner: Aito is a predictive database that returns instant, calibrated predictions for any field from your own live data using a single query, with no model training.
use_cases: Predict GL account or cost center for invoices
Route tickets or purchase orders to the right approver
Autofill form fields from one chosen field
Power smart search and product recommendations
Flag anomalies where a normal field has low prediction confidence
Gate LLM agent actions with calibrated predictions
summary.what_it_does: Aito is a predictive database where you upload your own tables and ask it to predict any field from any other fields using a JSON or SQL-like query, with no separate model per target. Each prediction returns a probability ($p) and can include the features behind it ($why). The page describes it as the predictive layer alongside generative LLMs, used for routine per-row decisions and as tools for agents. It can be run locally via a Docker container with an HTTP API, and a Postgres predict() function is offered via a hosted SQL endpoint. The page also lists use-case modules such as pattern discovery, smart forms, categorization and routing, and anomaly detection.
notable: Single-query predictions with calibrated confidence scores and no model training
Same query API runs locally in Docker and in the cloud
Postgres predict() function inside SELECT statements
EU-hosted (Ireland) with GDPR-ready and AES-256/TLS 1.3 claims
caveats: Free tier is limited to 10,000 rows per table and 50,000 rows total; production use requires a paid license at usage scale
Performance and accuracy figures (e.g., 90-98% accuracy, 20-168ms latency) are vendor-reported on the page
Some comparison claims are measured on v1 or v2 engines on small test sets, as stated on the page
